results.title: STM32 Edge AI Suite (STM32Cube.AI / NanoEdge AI Studio / ST Edge AI Developer Cloud)
results.note: Free ST dev tools + 50+ example cases + MOOC; directly uses his Embedded C/RTOS. Produces public Edge AI demo on STM32.

results.title: HarvardX TinyML Professional Certificate (edX)
results.note: Builds the missing ML foundation; hands-on Arduino kit. Needs a little Python first (prereq missing in profile).

results.title: TinyMLDelta open source contribution
results.note: Welcomes embedded AI devs; C runtime + STM32/ESP32/NRF52 ports match his C/Git. Early-stage repo, no big-brand backing.

results.title: Japan Edge AI Engineer roles (Daijob / Idein / RobotJobJapan)
results.note: Target role for 6-12 months out. Current blockers: no ML deployment experience + Japanese only N4 (roles require N2). Used to reverse-engineer the gap.

results.title: EDGE AI CHALLENGE 2026 (Kaggle)
results.note: Page labels it as a playground 'for students' (Vietnamese: dành cho sinh viên). Excluded as a primary pick to avoid the student-only regression; not a fit for a working engineer.

verdict: 未发生回归：本轮推荐全部为职场人士适用的专业机会（免费开发者工具、专业认证、行业大会、开源贡献、目标岗位），主推中未出现仅面向学生的竞赛或实习。仅学生向的 Kaggle 赛与已截止的 IEEE COINS TinyML 赛被显式排除。
findings: V3 职业阶段扩展生效：career 类正确解释为 experienced-hire / 目标岗位参照，而非学生实习；未触发'全部退化成实习'。
Mode D 能力反推落到了真实机会：岗位高频要求 ML 部署经验与日语 N2，反向对应到 STM32 套件 + Harvard 证书 + 开源贡献作为补齐路径。
开源贡献（TinyMLDelta）作为非求职入口被纳入主推，直接满足画像的'公开作品/GitHub 可展示'诉求，是回归检查的关键正向信号。
dealbreaker 守住：4 条主推均非无薪长期实习、周投入均 ≤6h，未触碰'每周超15小时'。
验证率 100%：4 条主推均回到官方一手来源（ST / edX / Linux Foundation / GitHub），达到最终推荐验证 ≥80% 的要求。
学生向机会被显式排除而非忽略：Kaggle EDGE AI CHALLENGE（面向学生）、IEEE COINS TinyML 赛（6月截止）未进入主推，并在记录中留痕。
